title: Extend date string parsing to handle "2018-03-03T11:22:48+01:00"
symptom: While investigating #316, the AndroidAPS.log had many entries with java.text.ParseException: Unparseable date: "2018-03-03T11:22:48+01:00" (at offset 19) in NSDeviceStatus.java.
cause: The thread suggests this is very likely an issue on AndroidAPS and not in xDrip, but no definitive root cause is established.
evidence_quote: This is very likely an issue on android aps and not in xDrip.
